finding: Composite factor (multi-indicator blend) produced 0% validation. Over-engineered signal with too many conditions cancels out edge.
Mean reversion with filters still 0% validation. Mean reversion consistently loses money at 18-720hr holds in crypto. Don't retry this family.
OBV divergence too noisy as standalone signal. Volume-based signals need trend confirmation layer.
RSI bounce (mean reversion) fails in trending crypto markets. RSI IC is +0.004 standalone — useless without strong trend filter.

All 6 Tier A strategies are momentum/trend variants with median pairwise r=+0.62. S11 alone (Sharpe 1.74) beats any equal-weight combo (1.22). Need different strategy families for real diversification.
BTC failed 3x but strong altcoin performance (84/329). Exception granted — some strategies work on altcoins but not BTC. Gate 4 BTC-only check may be too restrictive for non-momentum strategies.
RSI extreme reversal (RSI<15 / RSI>85) too rare and unreliable. Extreme RSI events in crypto often signal continued momentum, not reversal.
Funding rate mean reversion: 11.6% rate. Funding data sparse for many tokens and signal decays quickly. Only works on high-volume perps (BTC, ETH).
Momentum burst on perps (bidirectional) killed by funding rate drag on shorts. Spot-only variant (s11) works because no carry cost. Don't port long-only momentum to perp short side.

Cross-sectional momentum (rank by 14d return, long top quintile, weekly rebalance) provides genuine diversification vs Tier A momentum cluster. Sharpe 1.54, corr +0.25. Promoted to Tier A diversifier.

Sector rotation (10 sectors, top-2 by category momentum, regime filter) provides lowest correlation vs S11 of any strategy (+0.20). Privacy and Meme sectors drove most returns. Promoted to Tier A diversifier.

Pairs trading standalone Sharpe too low for Tier A, but near-zero correlation (-0.06) makes it exceptional diversifier. 50/50 blend with S11 cuts DD from -18% to -8%. Tier B diversifier. Needs z=3.0 entry threshold (z=2.0 loses money).
Regime-conditional weighting improves S11+S09 portfolio: Sharpe +0.29, DD +4.5pp. Key: zero allocation in CRISIS/DOWNTREND, full in UPTREND. QUIET regime = half allocation.
AND gate (enter only when both S11 and S09 agree) reduces trades 66% but improves Calmar +0.46, DD +6.7pp, avg trade PnL +68%. High-conviction filter — fewer but better trades.
Static universe look-ahead bias is modest: +0.28pp Sharpe, +0.44pp Calmar. Per-bar liquidity mask already handles 80% of bias. Worth correcting but not urgent.

Funding carry is a distinct family from mean reversion (s27) and momentum (s28). Harvests funding payment itself, not price prediction. Short-biased carry should diversify vs long-only momentum cluster. 160/360 perps have >50% funding coverage.

Funding carry IC increases with horizon (0.04 at 1d to 0.12 at 14d) — carry accumulates, unlike momentum which decays. Post-ETF carry compressed 36% but still 64% annualized on BTC. Cost-adjusted PF 1.47 at 28bps RT. 5/50 tokens negative — need token filtering.

Funding carry has zero signal overlap with all Tier A/B (0.003 corr with momentum). Engine handles funding, fees, slippage automatically for perps — validation.py results will be fully cost-adjusted. Post-ETF carry compressed 35% but still 65%+ annualized on BTC.

Funding carry prototype passes perf at 0.86ms. BTC is 100% short (structurally positive funding). Other tokens show both directions — SOL 28% long, CRV 32% long, AXS 86% long (negative funding). Strategy is bidirectional as designed.

BTC passes first attempt. Remarkable: beta -0.0006, corr -0.02 = genuinely market-neutral. Max DD only -1.6%. Return modest (+1.2% annual per-token) but cost-adjusted and uncorrelated. Must pass --market perp flag to validation.py.

Funding carry Tier B: 66/328 tokens (20.1%), but 91.2% among 30+ trade tokens. Rate limited by funding data, not strategy quality. First market-neutral strategy (beta=0.0, corr=0.002). Mean MaxDD -1.26%.
